title: Nine Pounds and One Name
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：baby　|　正文 310 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 baby 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the ① baby was nine days late and my grandfather said that was the whole of the family character. The ② baby, meaning the child and not the trouble, weighed nine pounds and did not cry; a baby, my grandmother said, is the only person who arrives with no opinions and leaves with several. She said the opinions arrive in the second year.

Every ③ baby in that street was weighed on the same scales and compared on the same afternoon. Their ④ baby — the one they had waited nine years for — slept through everything and woke in 1971; a baby, my mother said, is the only guest who changes the house and cannot be asked to leave. She said the changing takes eleven months.

My uncle, who was fifty, was called ⑤ the baby of the family and hated it, which my grandmother said was the point. The ⑥ baby, meaning the youngest and not the infant, is the only title you keep after you have stopped being one; a baby, she said, is either an age or a position, and only one of them ends. She said the position lasts forever.

By 1966 the ⑦ baby had become a person with nine words and one opinion. The ⑧ baby of the whole business, my father said in March, was the roof, and nobody else would touch it; a baby, he said, is either a child or the thing nobody else will take responsibility for. He said the roof was nine years overdue.

The ⑨ baby I remember is the one who weighed nine pounds, who is now taller than all of us. A ⑩ baby, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only person you can plan for completely and know nothing about; every baby, she said, is a stranger who has agreed to be related. She said the agreeing is the difficult half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 婴儿（指那个孩子，与麻烦相对）
C. n. 婴儿（指等了九年才来的那一个）
D. n. 宝贝；家里最小的（比喻义）
E. n. 家里最小的（抽象：这个身份）
F. n. 婴儿（指长成有九个词和一种看法的那个人）
G. n. 责任；由某人负责的事（比喻义）
H. n. 婴儿（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: the baby was nine days late
The baby, meaning the child and not the trouble
The baby, meaning the youngest and not the infant
the baby had become a person with nine words

answers.why: baby 意为“婴儿”，1963 年那个婴儿晚了九天，祖父说这就是这家人的全部性格。
baby 指“那个孩子”，与麻烦相对，婴儿重九磅，一声也没哭。
baby 意为“婴儿”，那条街上每一个婴儿都是用同一台秤称、在同一个下午被比较的。
baby 指等了九年才来的那一个，他们那个等了九年的婴儿什么事都能睡着，1971 年才醒过来。
baby 为比喻义，意为“宝贝、家里最小的”，五十岁的叔叔被称为家里的老小，他讨厌这个称呼，祖母说这正是要害。
baby 意为“家里最小的（这种身份）”，与婴儿相对，它是唯一你不再是了却仍然保留的称呼。
baby 指长成有九个词和一种看法的那个人，到 1966 年那个婴儿成了一个会说九个词、有一种看法的人。
baby 为比喻义，意为“由某人负责的事”，父亲三月说整件事里没人肯碰的就是屋顶。
baby 意为“婴儿”，我记得的是那个重九磅的婴儿，如今比我们所有人都高。
baby 为抽象总称，泛指“婴儿这种人”，祖母说婴儿是唯一你可以完全为他做计划、却对他一无所知的人。
